name: conducting-false-claims-analysis
description: Evaluates provider-side False Claims Act (31 U.S.C. 3729-3733) and Medicare and Medicaid overpayment exposure. Tests falsity, scienter, Escobar materiality and causation; computes the 401.305 60-day deadline (180-day suspension, 6-year lookback); quantifies from claims or a valid sample; models treble damages, penalties, OIG SDP, CMS SRDP and refunds. Covers FCA exposure, qui tam risk, overpayment quantification and settlement modeling once stark-law-aks-compliance finds noncompliance (1320a-7b(g) causation, Stark-tainted DHS claims); exposure and overpayment quantification for arrangements escalated by conducting-stark-law-analysis; MA risk-adjustment overpayments under 422.326; patterns of unsupported codes; one-sided or add-only chart reviews, raise-only CDI query policies, capture-count incentives; altered or backdated records in appeals and overpayments found during appeal review; subpoena, CID or unsealed qui tam response; 3730(h) retaliation. Counsel's opinion stays in stark-law-aks-compliance.
